desc.cn: 明晦炉具备的升级模块，能以投影定位的方式，将轻与重两类息壤完美渗入产线物品中，同时也能保证它们的活性可以各自激活，互不干扰。
desc.en: An upgrade module for the Forge of Luminance. It can use projection fixing to perfectly infuse materials with two different forms of Xiranite. This ensures that the reactivity profiles of both forms are free from mutual intervention and capable of inducing their own activities.

desc.cn: 明晦炉具备的升级模块，能以投影定位的方式，将重而粗粝的息壤渗入产线物品中。
desc.en: An upgrade module for the Forge of Luminance. It can use projection fixing to infuse materials with a coarse and heavy form of Xiranite.

desc.cn: 明晦炉具备的基础模块，能以投影定位的方式，将轻而细腻的息壤渗入产线物品中。
desc.en: A basic module for the Forge of Luminance. It can use projection fixing to infuse materials with a fine and light form of Xiranite.
